mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chatMessage (msgIdx, roomIdx, userIdx, content, msgType, sendDate) VALUES (chatMsgSeq.NEXTVAL, #{roomIdx}, #{userIdx}, #{content}, #{msgType}, SYSTIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT m.msgIdx, m.roomIdx, m.userIdx, m.content, m.msgType, TO_CHAR(m.sendDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS sendDate, u.nickname, u.profile_photo AS profilePhoto, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chatMember cm WHERE cm.roomIdx = m.roomIdx AND cm.lastReadDate < m.sendDate ) AS unreadCount FROM chatMessage m JOIN users u ON m.userIdx = u.userIdx WHERE m.roomIdx = #{roomIdx} ORDER BY m.msgIdx ASC
mapper.update: MERGE INTO chatMember cm USING (SELECT #{roomIdx} AS roomIdx, #{userIdx} AS userIdx FROM dual) src ON (cm.roomIdx = src.roomIdx AND cm.userIdx = src.userIdx) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET cm.lastReadDate = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (roomIdx, userIdx, lastReadDate) VALUES (src.roomIdx, src.userIdx, SYSTIMESTAMP)

INSERT INTO chatRoom(roomIdx, roomType, tradeIdx, roomName) VALUES (#{roomIdx}, 1, #{tradeIdx}, '거래채팅')
mapper.select: SELECT c.roomIdx, c.tradeIdx, u.userIdx, u.nickname, u.profile_photo AS profilePhoto, (SELECT content FROM (SELECT content FROM chatMessage WHERE roomIdx = c.roomIdx ORDER BY msgIdx DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS recentMessage, (SELECT TO_CHAR(sendDate, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM (SELECT sendDate FROM chatMessage WHERE roomIdx = c.roomIdx ORDER BY msgIdx DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS recentDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chatMessage m WHERE m.roomIdx = c.roomIdx AND m.userIdx != #{myUserIdx} AND m.sendDate > (SELECT lastReadDate FROM chatMember WHERE roomIdx = c.roomIdx AND userIdx = #{myUserIdx}) ) AS unreadCount FROM chatRoom c JOIN chatMember m ON c.roomIdx = m.roomIdx AND m.userIdx != #{myUserIdx} JOIN users u ON m.userIdx = u.userIdx WHERE c.tradeIdx = #{tradeIdx} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM chatMember WHERE roomIdx = c.roomIdx AND userIdx = #{myUserIdx} AND visible = 1) ORDER BY recentDate DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT p.productIdx, p.title, p.price, p.tradeStatus, p.userIdx as sellerIdx, TO_CHAR(p.createdDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdDate, (SELECT saveName FROM productImages WHERE productIdx = p.productIdx AND imgOrder = 1) AS saveName FROM product p WHERE p.productIdx = #{tradeIdx}

SELECT c.roomIdx, c.tradeIdx, u.userIdx, u.nickname, u.profile_photo AS profilePhoto, t.title AS tradeTitle, (SELECT saveName FROM productImages WHERE productIdx = c.tradeIdx AND imgOrder = 1) AS tradeSaveName, (SELECT content FROM (SELECT content FROM chatMessage WHERE roomIdx = c.roomIdx ORDER BY msgIdx DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS recentMessage, (SELECT TO_CHAR(sendDate, 'MM-DD HH24:MI') FROM (SELECT sendDate FROM chatMessage WHERE roomIdx = c.roomIdx ORDER BY msgIdx DESC) WHERE ROWNUM = 1) AS recentDate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chatMessage m WHERE m.roomIdx = c.roomIdx AND m.userIdx != #{myUserIdx} AND m.sendDate > (SELECT lastReadDate FROM chatMember WHERE roomIdx = c.roomIdx AND userIdx = #{myUserIdx}) ) AS unreadCount FROM chatRoom c JOIN chatMember my_m ON c.roomIdx = my_m.roomIdx AND my_m.userIdx = #{myUserIdx} AND my_m.visible = 1 JOIN chatMember other_m ON c.roomIdx = other_m.roomIdx AND other_m.userIdx != #{myUserIdx} JOIN users u ON other_m.userIdx = u.userIdx LEFT JOIN product t ON c.tradeIdx = t.productIdx ORDER BY recentDate DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chatMessage m JOIN chatMember cm ON m.roomIdx = cm.roomIdx AND cm.userIdx = #{myUserIdx} JOIN chatRoom cr ON m.roomIdx = cr.roomIdx WHERE m.userIdx != #{myUserIdx} AND m.msgType != 4 AND ( cr.roomType IN (2, 3) OR cm.visible = 1 ) AND m.sendDate > NVL(cm.lastReadDate, TO_TIMESTAMP('2000-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD'))
